rules.name: block-oversized-json
rules.expression: http.request.method in {"POST" "PUT" "PATCH"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/public/proof")) and http.request.body.size gt 131072
